messages.subject: Tribunal claim - Raymond Whitcombe
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We've had an ET1 come through from Raymond Whitcombe via the tribunal service. You'll remember he left us in January in the Midlands restructure. He's running a whistleblowing angle about the maintenance records at Coleshill, which we think is opportunistic but obviously we need to take it seriously.

Can your team take this on? Diane (HR) has the consultation file and Lesley can pull the payroll figures. Happy to have a call tomorrow.

Gordon

Gordon Sutherland
Managing Director
Sutherland Logistics Limited

messages.subject: RE: Tribunal claim - Raymond Whitcombe
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon,

Yes, of course - we'd be glad to act. Tom Gallagher will lead the day to day with me supervising. A few immediate points:

1. The response (ET3) deadline runs 28 days from when ACAS/the tribunal served the claim, so we need to move quickly. Please can Diane send the full consultation bundle (selection matrix, meeting notes, the at-risk letters) and Lesley the contract, payslips and the redundancy calculation.
2. The s.103A allegation is the one to focus on - if it succeeds the compensatory cap falls away, so the exposure is larger than an ordinary unfair dismissal.
3. Please preserve all emails and documents touching the September maintenance concerns and the selection scoring - do not delete anything.

I'll send an engagement letter today. Let's speak tomorrow at 11.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment & Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
